messages:
Aisha (oncall): FYI - we're seeing increased error rates for hosted inference in ap-southeast-1 since ~06:45 UTC. Impact: some customer traffic getting routed to fallback model (small throughput drop, tail latency increase). Investigating. /status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/IN-2026-asia-fallback
Evan: Confirming spikes in 90th/99th latency on model-redwood-v2 in ap-southeast-1. Error pattern: 502s from inference proxy, not model crashes.
deploy-bot: Rollback requested by @Aisha (oncall). Rollback initiated: service/proxy-ap-sg -> v1.4.2 -> rolling
Priya: We observed a surge of encrypted session creation failures to our regional auth endpt. Possibly linked to a recent cert rotation in the region.
Tom - eng-sre: Looking at control-plane logs now. KV cache eviction counts are normal. Proxy logs show repeated TLS handshake timeouts to model hosts.
Aisha (oncall): Immediate mitigation: route traffic to ap-east-1 and us-east-1 for affected customers; applied routing policy to reduce load on ap-southeast-1. Patch note pinned: https://internal.redwood.ai/ops/2026-03-23-apac-fallback
Maya - CS: Contacted top 5 impacted customers and opened tickets. Messaging: temporary degraded latency and fallback to alternate region. No data exposure. Customers updated at 07:02 UTC.
Evan: Hotfix: re-deployed proxy with handshake backoff fix + raised connection timeout to 12s. Rolling out to 50% of nodes now.
SRE Ops Bot: Canary results: 10/10 requests successful in canary, average latency down 18% vs. earlier spike. Monitoring for 15m before full rollout.
Priya: Reverted faulty cert on a subset of hosts which had wrong SANs. That seems to have dropped TLS errors in logs.
Tom - eng-sre: Keeping routing policy for 30m as precaution. Working on a postmortem checklist and timeline.
Aisha (oncall): Current status: partial service degradation in ap-southeast-1 mitigated. Traffic partially rerouted; full service expected in 30-45m pending rollout.
Maya - CS: Escalated SLAs to affected enterprise customers; CS team standby for follow-ups.
Aisha (oncall): Follow-ups: 1) postmortem + timeline in #postmortems 2) config verification sweep for cert rotation tooling 3) action item owners: @Priya (certs), @Tom (routing), @Evan (proxy). I'll send an internal incident summary in 2h. :white_check_mark:
